implementation: Opt-in TERMITE_METAL_Q4_0_BATCH_INVARIANT=1; safe canonical OCR cohorts remain the default.
hardware: Apple M4 Max, 32 GPU cores, 36 GiB unified memory
scope: Q4_0 F32 linear and fused gate/up activation for 2–8 rows. Singleton portfolio selected with rows=1; kernel launch grid.y uses actual cohort size. Generated/JIT and row-dependent small-batch reductions bypassed. Fused attention and FFN down/sumsq/norm/residual tails retain canonical row-one family. The OCR experiment also retains row-one QKV, PLE and final head families.
qualification: Bitwise operator equality is a necessary gate, not proof of whole-decoder equality or OCR accuracy. Full transcript and completion counts, caps, missing pages and bracketing ordinary controls determine eligibility. Diagnostic timings excluded.

gpu_tests.references: Framed singleton; distinct inputs and residuals; fused projection references also traversed in reverse row order. Fused gate/up counter checks one dispatch per cohort when singleton fused policy is active.

fixture_recovery.reason: Original PDF/PNG cache was no longer present on continuation. Invalid-manifest campaigns are setup failures excluded from all output and throughput claims.
fixture_recovery.pdf_hashes: All three re-downloaded public PDF SHA256 values match the original manifest.
fixture_recovery.raster_hashes: All eight original pages and all sixteen expanded text pages match the committed prior corpus SHA256 values.
fixture_recovery.renderer: Poppler pdftoppm -r 150 -scale-to 1536 -png; rendering excluded from recognition timing.

shared_machine_timing: Unrelated compiler activity was observed before the updated campaign. These are local recognition measurements; passing disjoint ranges do not establish an independently replicated production speedup.
